responsibility: Implements a RISC-V-specific RTL optimization pass, `vect_permconst`, that reduces constant-pool loads of integer vector permutation constants. Working per basic block, it hashes normalized `CONST_VECTOR` values seen in `REG_EQUAL` notes on vector loads, detects later constants that differ only by a small uniform bias, verifies the earlier register value is still available, and replaces the second constant-pool load with a derived vector add (`vadd.vi`-style RTL) from the prior constant, making it a specialized late RVV constant-synthesis optimization rather than part of generic vector instruction selection.
